verdict.rationale: A runtime probe verified against official docs reports that Godot ships a built-in GDScript language server that any external editor or agent tooling can attach to. It also reports a first-party VS Code LSP client in the official godotengine org, and the docs confirm external-editor workflows. The evidence comes mainly from a single probe summary, not in-depth first-party LSP docs. missing for 10: first-party documentation detailing LSP completions, diagnostics, and navigation; C# typed API tooling evidence; independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the scripting language has first-class machine tooling — an official language server (LSP) or typed API definitions a coding agent's editor can attach to for completions, diagnostics, and navigation

citations.quote: Godot ships a BUILT-IN GDScript language server (LSP) any external editor or agent tooling can attach to
godotengine/godot-vscode-plugin (official org, 2,130 stars, pushed 2026-09-10) is its first-party LSP client
Godot can be used with an external text editor, such as Sublime Text or Visual Studio Code.
